# NabilLogs - Tech & Software Engineering Blog

> Full-stack software development articles, database optimization notes, and MERN stack insights.

## Core Topics
- [Databases](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/posts?cat=db): MongoDB query optimization and indexing strategies.
- [Web Design](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/posts?cat=webD): Responsive Tailwind CSS and frontend patterns.
- [App Development](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/posts?cat=appd): React and state management guides.
- [SEO](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/posts?cat=seo): Full-stack JavaScript SEO best practices.
- [Marketing](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/posts?cat=marketing): Content strategy and audience growth notes.

## Site
- [Home](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/): Latest posts, featured articles, and category browsing.
- [All Posts](https://nabillogs.vercel.app/posts): Full archive of published articles.
